senses.gloss: the steel-coating of cutting tools, steel-edge (cmp. אִסְטְמָא).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 13:4">Kel. XIII, 4</cite> <he>נטל חִיסּוּמָן</he> if their steel-edge is worn off.

I, 64ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 13">Gen. R. s. 13</cite>, end; a. e.—
